name: Quick Strike
description: A fast attack that is difficult to avoid.

name: Crushing Blow
description: A powerful physical attack that deals heavy damage.

name: Frost Breath
description: Exhales freezing air that damages and slows enemies.

name: Flight
description: Allows the creature to travel through the air.

name: Venomous Bite
description: A bite that poisons the target.

name: Web Trap
description: Creates sticky webs that restrain enemies.

name: Shield Bash
description: Strikes an enemy with a shield.

name: Stone Skin
description: Hardens the creature's body to resist damage.

name: Fireball
description: Launches a ball of flame at an enemy.

name: Shadow Step
description: Allows the creature to move quickly through shadows.
